features.description: Generic declared-version/required-command adapter, submit-once handoff, independent publisher, queue-owned versions, fenced renewable lease, atomic publication/receipts and bounded original clean-candidate/receipt continuation.
General conflict recovery, safe whitespace correction, native derived identities, committed-runner migration and optional explicitly authorized AI repair remain planned.
